in_hebrew.name: Asabi
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Asabi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'asabe', meaning 'to give'. This name signifies a gift from God, often bestowed upon those who have shown great faith and devotion.

in_greek.name: Asabi
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Gift of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Asabi είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'asabe', meaning 'to give'. This name signifies a gift from God, often bestowed upon those who have shown great faith and devotion.

in_latin.name: Asabi
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gift of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Asabi est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'asabe', meaning 'to give'. This name signifies a gift from God, often bestowed upon those who have shown great faith and devotion.
